description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'ModerationOptOutUnpublish' that extends the 'UnpublishAction' class. It provides an alternative unpublish action that skips unpublishing entities under moderation, with custom access control logic and user warnings.

classes.name: ModerationOptOutUnpublish
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides an unpublish action which skips entities under moderation, with custom access logic and user warnings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes services for moderation info, bundle info, and messaging.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the entity is moderated; if so, adds a warning and forbids unpublishing; otherwise, defers to parent access control.
